section_anchor: The same number, three different feelings
brief_summary: Three-panel glyph strip of force-over-travel sketches for a linear, a tactile, and a clicky switch, all within a 10g actuation band of each other: Cherry MX2A Red (45g actuation / 75g bottom-out, smooth rising line), Durock T1 (55g actuation / 67g bottom-out, curve with a bump at actuation), Kailh Box Jade (50g actuation / 70g bottom-out, same bump shape plus a drawn click-mark burst at actuation). Only values present in the article's own table are plotted; no bump-peak force is invented.
